meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目新版本发布到 npm 并验证发布产物
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要一键把代码包发布到 npm 并确认发布成功
copy.tagline_en: Publish a new version of your project to npm and verify the outputs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ship a code package to npm and confirm it succeeded

howto.what: 安装后,要求发布新版本时,Claude 会执行完整发布流程:触发 GitHub 自动构建、等待成功、核对 npm 软件包版本、整理并应用版本说明、在 Discord 发公告,全部完成才结束。
howto.when: 当你说“publish”“release”“deploy”等关键词,或要求发布到 npm 时触发;它会先确认版本升级类型(patch/minor/major),没给的话会先问你。

say.text: 发布一个新版本,patch 级别。
say.note: 它会触发发布流程,先确认版本号。

say.text: 把当前改动发布到 npm,用 minor 版本。
say.note: Claude 走完整发布流程包括 Discord 公告。

say.text: 帮我发布 major 版本并更新版本说明。

howto.what_en: After install, when asked to publish, Claude runs the full release pipeline: trigger GitHub Actions, wait for success, verify npm versions, draft/apply release notes, post to Discord, then finish.
howto.when_en: Triggers on keywords like publish, release, deploy, or npm publish. Requires a bump type (patch/minor/major); if missing, Claude asks before proceeding.

say_en.note: Runs the full workflow with a patch bump.

say_en.text: Publish the current changes to npm as a minor version.
Release a major version and update the release notes.
